role: The overworld populate driver: ChunkProviderGenerate.populate in vanilla order (seed, the four structure generators out of their own HashMap-ordered structure maps, water and lava lakes, dungeons, decorate, the ice and snow pass), the structure-map bookkeeping every generated chunk extends, the world-spawn biome search, and Chunk.func_150809_p's populated-flag relight.

structs.name: POP_TYPES
structs.java: ChunkProviderGenerate's four MapGenStructure fields in field order

gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
lines 200-224, function populate_add_start: saves, nulls and restores the global populate_world_rand around the start build
lines 172 and 213, functions populate_offer_chunk and populate_add_start: realloc growth of each structure map's start array on chunk generation
line 319, function map_order: realloc of the order scratch
line 241, function populate_biome_spawn_search: malloc of the 129x129 biome grid (world creation)
lines 312-329, function map_order: container-order dependence carried deliberately as java.util.HashMap iteration order through jhm64_order
line 390, function populate_structures: sc_generate over structure pieces; sc_free_ents frees the per-call entity list (line 394)
line 448, function populate_precipitation_height: while loop bounded by y > 0
line 86, function chunk_at: world_load_chunk may generate neighbour chunks from inside populate
function start_reload: a mineshaft start's pieces read back from the environment's blob file (regionspill.c) and malloc'd inside the tick, when a population meets a start the park spilled
tables COLUMN_EMIT (light sources by an id's low byte) and PRECIP_STOP (the precipitation walk's stops by id), built before main (lane/popfeat)
notes: Runs whenever a chunk is populated, which in whole-server replay happens inside the server tick (seedworld.c and serverreplay-driven chunk loads); tick_path true on that basis. decorator_decorate and decorator_negative_* are declared in populate.h but live in decorator.c. The Java member names for MapGenStructure.func_151538_a and StructureStart.generateStructure were taken from the port's comments and naming, not re-opened in oracle/src. lane/envmem: pop_start.pop_left frees a mineshaft's or village's pieces once every chunk that can reach it has populated (its key stays: the map order is of every key ever put); populate_spill_far keeps a far mineshaft's pieces in the blob file. sky_column_check walks a column by band pointer and tests a band's 16 cells below the first loop for a light source at once (COLUMN_EMIT); populate_precipitation_height walks by band (PRECIP_STOP); populate_freeze computes a column's biome and perlin drop once and skips the drop when the biome's temperature decides the test (COLUMN_DROP_MAX) (lane/popfeat).
